lines.zh: 我被召唤出来，先四处走走。
lines.en: Summoned here, I take a walk first.

lines.zh: 我绕着这座建筑转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half of this building.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下发出闷响。
lines.en: The ground groans under my feet.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上踏下来，一级一级。
lines.en: I step down the stairs, one by one.
I know the way along this road.

lines.zh: 没有草原可巡，就在院子里走。
lines.en: No savanna to patrol, so I pace the yard.
I drag my steps and circle slowly.

lines.zh: 这一圈走完，就到你身边。
lines.en: Once around, and I'll be beside you.
My shadow moves along the wall.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻些，别惊动屋主。
lines.en: I soften my steps so the owner isn't startled.

lines.zh: 我在石砖上一步一步走。
lines.en: I walk the stone tiles step by step.

lines.zh: 往那边去，我闻到活人了。
lines.en: Over there; I smell the living.
I lean on the wall with my arms crossed.

lines.zh: 召唤我的那个人，还没出现。
lines.en: The one who summoned me hasn't shown.
I look up and count the roof tiles.
This place is too small to stretch out.
I press my knuckles and wait for orders.
Quiet, as if waiting for a brawl.

lines.zh: 我不动，尘土就落在我肩上。
lines.en: I stay still and dust settles on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 这么大的个子，站着也占地方。
lines.en: Big as I am, I take up space just standing.

lines.zh: 我吐了口气，把地上的灰吹开。
lines.en: I exhale and blow the dust off the floor.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等着，谁也过不去。
lines.en: I wait here, and no one passes.
My neck is stiff; I roll it.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，跟草原不一样。
lines.en: This place smells different from the savanna.
I narrow my eyes at the door.

lines.zh: 墙角的影子很长，不是我的。
lines.en: The shadow in the corner is long, and not mine.
Did you bring me here?

lines.zh: 我低头，脑袋挡住半个门。
lines.en: I lower my head and block half the doorway.
Little one, you stand up straight.

lines.zh: 我看了看你的手，又看你的眼。
lines.en: I look at your hands, then your eyes.
You bear the marks of a summoning.

lines.zh: 我这身力气，你打算怎么用？
lines.en: All this strength of mine, how do you plan to use it?
I tilt my head and hear you out.
You don't look like a fighter.

lines.zh: 我的手掌能盖住你的脸。
lines.en: My palm can cover your face.
I lower my eyes, waiting for you to go on.
I have your voice now.

lines.zh: 别躲在我身后，我不习惯。
lines.en: Don't hide behind me; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 你这副样子，是来下命令的？
lines.en: Looking like that, have you come to give orders?
I stoop to your eye level.
I stare at you without blinking.

lines.zh: 把你的站位记在脑子里。
lines.en: I file away where you stand.
Don't let your hand shake; I haven't moved.
Ask, and I'll answer.
This body still feels pain.
You hit my ribs.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞你一下够呛。
lines.en: This bulk of mine hits hard.
A summoned thing can still be hurt.
This pain is somewhat new.
I press my palm to the wound, silent.
You really dared to strike.
Fine, I'll change my stance.
My hide is thick, but you're accurate.
Give me a moment.

lines.zh: 你带了吃的？这倒没想到。
lines.en: You brought food? Didn't expect that.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，吃多少都不够。
lines.en: With this body, no amount of food is enough.

lines.zh: 那味道，比我等的人有意思。
lines.en: That smell is more interesting than who I'm waiting for.
Give it here; I'll taste it for you.
I reach out and take it.

lines.zh: 这一口，就当跑腿的工钱。
lines.en: This bite counts as wages for the errand.
Don't pull it back so quickly.
My stomach is indeed growling.
With food, I'm easier to talk to.

lines.zh: 这点东西，塞不住我的牙。
lines.en: This won't fill the gaps in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，你就过不去了。
lines.en: I stand in the doorway and you can't pass.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，看清楚谁更沉。
lines.en: Bump me and see who's heavier.
This space is narrow to begin with.
Step back; even turning is hard for me.
My shoulder scrapes the stone pillar.
Don't walk so close; you'll trip.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你就撞上来了。
lines.en: I didn't move, and you walked into me.
This frame is inconvenient indoors.
The thud is loud in the stone hall.
I raise a hand to wave you around.

lines.zh: 我这副模样，也被召来配对。
lines.en: Even looking like this, I was summoned to pair.

lines.zh: 她比我矮一点，力气不小。
lines.en: She's a bit shorter, and no weaker.

lines.zh: 我们撞了撞肩膀，算认识。
lines.en: We bump shoulders as a greeting.
The yard is small; we can only stand side by side.
I keep my hands light so I don't hurt her.

lines.zh: 我们低声说着草原的事。
lines.en: We speak quietly of the savanna.

lines.zh: 这地方不适合养小个子。
lines.en: This place is no good for raising young.
When she laughs, I laugh too.

lines.zh: 召唤物也有自己的季节。
lines.en: Even summoned things have their seasons.
We stood side by side all night.
I crouch and pinch it up between two fingers.
It hit the ground, so I grabbed it first.

lines.zh: 屋里的小物件，归我保管。
lines.en: Small things in this room are mine to keep.

lines.zh: 我把它放在掌心看了看。
lines.en: I set it in my palm and look at it.
Heavy enough to serve as a weapon.
I'll carry this on me.
I stoop, pick it up, tuck it in my belt.

lines.zh: 捡起来的时候，地砖响了。
lines.en: As I pick it up, the tile creaks.
Tuck it in my belt so it doesn't drop.
This is useful; I won't be polite.
The order came; it's you, isn't it.

lines.zh: 脚步一顿，转向你的方向。
lines.en: My steps halt and turn your way.

lines.zh: 这屋里，只有你值得动手。
lines.en: In this room, only you are worth striking.

lines.zh: 我这一身厚皮，挨打不疼。
lines.en: This thick hide of mine does not feel hits.

lines.zh: 我这一身横肉，专为推人长的。
lines.en: This bulk was grown for shoving.

lines.zh: 被召唤来打架，我不挑对手。
lines.en: Summoned to fight, I don't pick opponents.
I raise my fist; you should understand.
Target clear; engage.
I fix on your shoulder.
Good, I accept this bout.

lines.zh: 你躲不掉，这屋子没几处。
lines.en: You can't dodge; there are few places here.
I turn sideways and block the door.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就进一步，肚子挡路。
lines.en: You step back, I step forward; my belly blocks the way.
Broad body, but these fists drop fast.
I don't shout; I just come.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人，想看这个吧。
lines.en: Whoever summoned me must want this.
I close in slowly along the wall.

lines.zh: 这屋子小，我的腿长了点。
lines.en: The room is small; my legs are a bit long.
You change position; so do I.
I keep my fists at my waist.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在石头上来回。
lines.en: Your steps echo on the stone.
I've judged the distance.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就靠近一步。
lines.en: When you turn, I take a step closer.
No rush; I have more strength than you.
The hall's echo doesn't fool me.
I lift my foot, ready to press down.
You've shrunk into the corner.
I've waited long enough for this.
I watch you across a table.
Better not breathe so loudly.
I go around that pillar.
Almost; just an arm's length.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow is swallowed by mine.
I raise my hand; the last moment.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，把门框打裂了。
lines.en: My punch splits the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，往上一提。
lines.en: I grab your arm and haul you up.
Gravel flies from beside my hand.
The blow pins you to the wall.

lines.zh: 我这身重量，压下来就是墙。
lines.en: My weight coming down is a wall.

lines.zh: 别硬挡，你的骨头不够粗。
lines.en: Don't block it; your bones aren't thick enough.

lines.zh: 我把你摔在地上，地砖裂了。
lines.en: I throw you down and the tile cracks.
Consider this a light blow.
My knee drives up.
You back away quickly, at least.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手，骨头还在响。
lines.en: I shake my hand; the bones still ring.
The sound circles the room three times.
I kick a stool flying.
This punch goes for your chest.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的领子扔向墙。
lines.en: I grab your collar and fling you at the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下，把尘土都震起来了。
lines.en: That one shook the dust loose.

lines.zh: 我被召唤到这块地砖上。
lines.en: I am summoned onto this tile.
The air tightens, and I appear.
Giran, mission form.

lines.zh: 有人要打架，所以我来了。
lines.en: Someone wants a fight, so I came.

lines.zh: 我从光里踏出来，先看四周。
lines.en: I step out of the light and scan the room.
This room is shorter than I am.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是被人叫来的。
lines.en: This body of mine was called here.
The dust settles and I stand ready.

lines.zh: 我不是自然长出来的，记住。
lines.en: I didn't grow here naturally; remember that.

lines.zh: 召唤的痕迹还在我脚边。
lines.en: The summoning marks still ring my feet.
I brush my shoulder and step before you.
I'm here; don't send me back yet.
I rest my hand on the doorframe.

lines.zh: 这里的地板承受得住我吗？
lines.en: Can this floor hold me?
What's the task? Speak.
I take my stance and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我在这片空间里显得太大。
lines.en: I look too big in this space.
First, give me an opponent.

lines.zh: 火苗贴在我身上，皮都发紧。
lines.en: Flames cling to me and my hide tightens.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，砸裂了地砖。
lines.en: I fall from above and crack the tiles.

lines.zh: 水进了喉咙，我咳得厉害。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I cough hard.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整间屋子震得发响。
lines.en: The blast makes the whole room ring.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的前臂上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my forearm.

lines.zh: 这股力量压着我，抬不起手。
lines.en: This force presses me down; I can't lift a hand.

lines.zh: 饿得我连拳头都攥不住。
lines.en: Hunger keeps my fists from closing.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，光都从骨头里透出来。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and light shows through my bones.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面，我踩不到东西。
lines.en: No ground in the void; I have nothing to stand on.
